summary.intent: First, verify a Strava map-rendering fix (route follows newest activity trace) using seeded fixture data via wrangler dev; then pivot the app's mood-quote catalogue from Ted Lasso quotes/GIFs to cited, historically accurate Machiavelli passages and public-domain images.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the map fix visually with a seeded ride/tennis snapshot, then fully replaced the Ted Lasso catalogue with 10 renamed moods backed by cited Machiavelli passages and 10 verified public-domain Wikimedia images, updated dependent copy/tests/docs, fixed a media-selection bug, restored a dropped accent, and pushed the work as feat/machiavelli-catalogue (460 tests passing, 99.4%/96.9% coverage).

repo: `npm run dev` fails due to a wrangler compatibility-date mismatch; the working command is `npx wrangler dev --test-scheduled --compatibility-date=2026-07-08`

Mood catalogue (`src/data/moods.ts`) is treated as the versioned source of truth for content; mood `id`s are engine keys read by selection logic and pinned by tests, while `Mood.name` is the only reader-facing label
Catalogue tests require ≥3 quotes per mood and previously pinned exact display names like `getMood("believe")?.name`, causing churn on any rename
`Quote.character` field stores citation text now but can't be renamed because snapshots already persisted in KV reference `quote.character`
Accent colors per mood were contrast-verified (3:1) against both stocks in an earlier pass and must be reused as-is to keep that verification valid
Home page mood name is stored in the KV snapshot at seed time, so a source fix (e.g., accent restoration) won't show until re-seeding
All non-tile external media (Giphy previously, now Wikimedia images) is fetched directly by the visitor's browser rather than proxied, unlike the established `/tiles/` proxy pattern for map tiles

code.finding: pickQuote returns a field named `media`, not `gif`; a seeding script assuming `gif` will silently show `media: none`

workflow: Before large content pivots, read the underlying data structure and selection logic first to understand semantic mapping before proposing replacement content
Verify external asset URLs (public-domain image links) resolve with real HTTP checks before writing them into source, rather than guessing/trusting search results
When renaming pinned test assertions, prefer having tests read from the catalogue/source of truth dynamically instead of hardcoding values, to avoid repeated churn on future renames
Log significant content/scope decisions into CLAUDE.md so they persist across sessions (e.g., the rule that only chapter-citable Machiavelli passages are used)

friction: `npm run dev` / `npm wrangler run dev` typo and the underlying compatibility-date mismatch repeatedly blocks the simple dev-server start command
Generic Wikimedia Commons search for Machiavelli images was noisy; had to pull directly from the dedicated Commons category instead
Seeding script bug (`gif` vs `media` field mismatch) caused a silent failure (media showing as none) that required re-checking `pickQuote`
Accent restoration didn't visibly take effect until re-seeding, because mood name was baked into the already-seeded KV snapshot
A stray pre-existing em dash was found on a line already being touched, requiring an extra cleanup pass per the project's rule
